utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: We have an urgent problem, our production outage started an hour ago.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your account right away.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: This is concerning, last time there was downtime too. I'm not sure this will work for us long term.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Totally understand the worry, let's get this fixed first.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Also what does the premium support tier cost? Is there a discount?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Premium support is included in the enterprise plan.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Who is the best person on your team for escalations? Who is my contact?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Priya Patel is your success manager, she handles escalations.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good. Let's schedule a follow up call next week and send an action item list.
